# SoraIcon

Renders trusted, static SVG path data as a decorative or a named icon.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | foundation |
| Import | `import { SoraIcon } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraIcon from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraIcon'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/foundation/SoraIcon.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/foundation/SoraIcon.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` **(required)** | `SoraIconDefinition` |  | Trusted path data, e.g. one of the `icon*` exports. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name. Omit for a decorative icon, which is hidden from assistive technology. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Fixed size. Omit to scale with the surrounding text (`1em`). |

## Attributes

The `<svg>` element.

## Accessibility

- Without `label` the icon is `aria-hidden`; with `label` it is `role="img"` with that name.
- Only glyphs marked `directional` mirror in right-to-left text.
- Path data comes from static definitions; nothing is injected with `v-html`.

## Styling

- `.sora-icon`
- inherits `color` (`currentColor`) and scales with `font-size` unless `size` is set

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FoundationDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FoundationDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-sora-muted">
  <SoraIcon :icon="iconCheck" size="sm" />
  <SoraIcon :icon="iconSun" size="md" />
  <SoraIcon :icon="iconSearch" size="lg" :label="t('demo.icon.named')" />
  <SoraIcon :icon="iconChevronRight" size="lg" />
  <SoraBadge color="info"
    ><template #leading><SoraIcon :icon="iconCheck" /></template>{{ t('demo.badge.active') }}</SoraBadge
  >
</div>
```
